answer: Duplicate identities fracture like a plume dispersing over a lagoon, since cloning the keystone invalidates the bond and forfeits the full stake. Adversaries must acquire and maintain genuine attestations at real cost per identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
